art.mood: Curious, wry, a little decadent, personal, and knowingly imperfect.
art.medium: Layered photocopied paper, worn ink, scribbled marks, rough cutouts, halftone, and purposeful breathing room.

houseStyle.name: Clumsy scribbly punk collage
houseStyle.subject: One story-specific object or scene, with a clear visual claim rather than a generic technology symbol.
houseStyle.composition: Asymmetrical hand-drawn or cut-paper composition with foreground, middle, and background layers; vary crop, scale, and focal position between neighboring images. Reserve a textured title zone on covers without leaving a broad empty color field.
houseStyle.surface: Scratchy uneven ink, loose marks, halftone, rough paper, slight print misregistration, overlapping folds and paper shadows, and hand-cut edges; keep texture out of reading text.
houseStyle.color: Select a named companion palette per issue; use its dark ink and light paper as anchors, and vary accent intensity by scene.
houseStyle.avoid: Polished photorealistic gloss, generic robots, repeated subject silhouettes, uniform border frames, large unused color fields, in-image text, and stock-art symmetry.

fieldNoteSticker.selection: One strongest Field Note per issue; all other notes stay unstickered.
fieldNoteSticker.subject: A concrete object or event from the featured note, not a generic personal-life symbol.
fieldNoteSticker.medium: Transparent die-cut collage of torn paper, scratchy ink, photocopy grain, halftone, and a few crooked marker or tape marks.
fieldNoteSticker.color: Anchor in the issue palette; use one companion accent where it helps the subject.
fieldNoteSticker.avoid: Clean vector icon, rectangular background, stock badge, reused sticker, tiny illegible detail, or in-image text.
